title: edapack build-inputs
description: Declarative description of a tool's input components, resolved by resolve-inputs.py.

name.description: Unique input name; used as the manifest key.

repo.description: Git URL used to resolve refs (git ls-remote / releases API).

policy.description: Resolution policy: branch:<b> | tag:<t> | latest-release | latest-tag[:<tag-filter-regex>].

release_policy.description: Core only. How the release track finds the newest upstream release. Absent means the package has no release track. Use latest-tag[:<regex>] for upstreams that publish tags but no GitHub Releases; the regex filters candidate tags before version-sorting, e.g. ^v\d+\.\d+$ to ignore rc tags.

version_probe.description: Core only. '<path>:<key>' naming a file and macro/assignment to read the in-development version from when the policy is a branch (which yields no version from the ref alone), e.g. configure.ac:AC_INIT.

release_notes.description: Core only. Either a path to the upstream changelog in the core repo (e.g. Changes), whose section for the built version becomes the release body on the release track; or the literal 'gh-compare', for an upstream with no changelog and empty release bodies, which instead lists the pull requests merged between the previously released upstream ref and this one.

track.description: If false, recorded in the manifest but excluded from inputs_digest (no change-gate trigger).
